name: A Maimed Rite
source:
Lynus is getting ready to celebrate the Harvest Festival with his friends, but it seems like he's going to have to address other issues first.

[From [url=https://princessinternetcafe.itch.io/a-maimed-rite]itch.io[/url]]

莱纳斯正准备与朋友们一同庆祝丰收祭，不过看起来，他得先解决眼前的其他麻烦才行。
